displayedInputs.question:
A cylinder has 2 bases. If its lateral surface is also counted, what is “the number of bases + 1”?

[Figure 1](attached-image-1)

What is the distance from any point on the surface of a sphere to its center?

[Figure 1](attached-image-2)

choices.A: For some points, it equals the diameter
choices.B: It equals the radius for every point
choices.C: It can be any positive number

displayedInputs.question:
What is a generatrix of a cone?

[Figure 1](attached-image-3)

choices.B: The line segment representing the height, which must equal the radius
choices.C: A line segment joining the vertex to a point on the circumference of the base
choices.D: The width of the net of the lateral surface

displayedInputs.question:
A solid is formed by joining 1 cylinder and 1 cone. How many basic solids are there?

[Figure 1](attached-image-4)

If a small sphere is removed from a large sphere, how should the remaining volume be calculated?

[Figure 1](attached-image-5)

choices.B: Calculate only the volume of the small sphere
choices.C: Take the difference between the surface areas
choices.D: Subtract the volume of the small sphere from the volume of the large sphere

displayedInputs.question:
What is the surface area of a cube with edge length 3?

[Figure 1](attached-image-6)

What is the surface area of a rectangular prism with length, width, and height 2, 3, and 4, respectively?

[Figure 1](attached-image-7)

The lateral surface of a cylinder unfolds into a rectangle. If its base circumference is 10 and its height is 4, what is its lateral surface area?

[Figure 1](attached-image-8)
